hero.photoAlt: A sunlit living room with a daybed and an arched doorway

credentials.text: A fixed design fee, agreed first

servicesIntro: Most of our work is in Bowral, Mittagong and Moss Vale, from one tired lounge room to a whole renovation.

services.name: Full home design
services.desc: Layout, colour, joinery, lighting and furniture, drawn and specified.

services.name: One room
services.desc: A lounge, kitchen or bedroom, designed and sourced.

services.name: Colour and styling consult
services.desc: Two hours in your home, with a written plan after.

feesIntro: Fees are fixed and agreed in writing before we start. Furniture is supplied at trade price, and we show you the discount.

process.title: A home visit
process.desc: We walk through, talk about how you live, and measure up.

process.title: A concept
process.desc: Mood boards, a floor plan and a costed list, before you commit.

process.title: Install day
process.desc: We deliver, place and style everything, usually in one day.

faq.q: Do you work outside the Southern Highlands?
faq.a: Yes, across NSW for full-home projects. Travel is quoted up front.

faq.q: Can I use furniture I already have?
faq.a: Of course. Most of our designs keep a few loved pieces.

faq.q: How long does a room take?
faq.a: About six weeks from concept to install, depending on furniture lead times.

contactIntro: Or save our details and call when it suits you.
